rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment Rent Increase Limit
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase permanent rent ceilings by up to 1.0% beginning no earlier than January 1, 2026. This increase cannot be applied to tenancies that commenced on or after January 1, 2025 where rent was set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

coverage.summary: Rent-stabilized units in Berkeley with qualifying tenancies
coverage.unresolvable: Excludes tenancies commencing on or after January 1, 2025 whose rent was set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rent set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
